items.text: cheque book chahiye
kab milega
cancel karna hai
hao
nahi mil gaya
abhi batao

items.context: When do you need the cheque book?
items.text: jaldi bhejo

items.context: Do you want to update your address before dispatch?
items.text: address change karna hai

items.context: Should I check the status of your cheque book delivery?
items.text: delivery confirm karo
mera cheque book last month request kiya tha vo abhi tak nahi mila
kya main naye branch address par cheque book bhejwa sakta hu
please bataye mera current cheque book delivery ka status kya hai
maine cheque book order kiya tha par ab tak dispatch confirmation nahi aaya
kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki mera cheque book kab tak milega
mere account me naye check books ke liye kitna time lagta hai generally
kya cheque book ki delivery address proof verify hone ke baad hi hoti hai

items.context: Do you want to request a new cheque book?
items.text: haan mujhe nayi cheque book chahiye please bhej do
mera address change hua hai to us par bhejna hai please

items.context: When did you place the order for the cheque book?
items.text: maine ek hafta pehle order diya tha but abhi tak delivery nahi hui

items.context: Do you want to collect the cheque book from branch or get it delivered?
items.text: kya main apne branch se bhi cheque book le sakta hu ya delivery hi hoti hai

items.context: Do you want me to check the delivery status of your cheque book?
items.text: kya aap mujhe tracking kar ke bata sakte hain ki cheque book kaha tak pahucha hai
maine pichle mahine apne account ke liye cheque book ka order diya tha lekin abhi tak use receive nahi kiya hu
kya aap mujhe batayenge ki mera cheque book kab tak dispatch ho kar mere address par pahucha diya jayega
mera address change hua tha isliye main sure karna chahta hu ki cheque book mere naye address par hi bheja jaye

items.context: Please tell me why your cheque book has not been delivered yet?
items.text: main cheque book ke liye call kar raha hu kyunki maine order diya tha aur use deliver nahi kiya gaya hai

items.context: Are you planning to pick up the cheque book from branch or want home delivery?
items.text: kya mujhe apke branch se cheque book lene ke liye appointment lena padega ya bina appointment ke aa sakta hu

items.context: Can you please confirm your full name and account type for cheque book request?
items.text: mera naam Rajesh Kumar hai aur main nayi cheque book ke liye apply karna chahta hu apne current account ke liye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: cheque_book - requests a new cheque book or asks about its delivery
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
